newsitem.title: USA: Triumph sees backlog boosting FY 97 results.
newsitem.headline: Triumph sees backlog boosting FY 97 results.

text.p: Triumph Group Inc said Wednesday that it was optimistic about the rest of 1997, following the release of first quarter earnings of $4.5 million, or $0.43 per share, sharply higher than in the year-earlier period.

In a statement accompanying earnings, Richard Ill, chief executive officer, said, "Triumph's results in the first quarter are due to the continuation of strong market conditions in our Aviation Group and the improvement in operating margins in our Metals Group."

Looking ahead to the remainder of the year, Ill said, "we expect to report strong results. We have a substantial backlog of business in our Aviation Group, and we are confident that Triumph will continue to achieve both internal and external growth."
Triumph designs, engineers, manufactures, repairs and overhauls aircraft components.
